milestone_red.assertion: Bound approval and confirmed publication could not produce a durable PR completion receipt.

assertions: PR-only status stayed incomplete despite its publication receipt.
Compiled CLI did not accept --wait or --timeout-secs.

head_freshness_red.assertion: Wait returned PR success from an old receipt after the remote PR head changed.

head_timeout_red.assertion: Final remote observation returned success after a 5-second scripted delay despite a 1-second wait timeout.

verified: A lease-fenced PR milestone requires current-binding approved review evidence, a bound PR and a confirmed Push/CreatePr operation. A receipt survives restart; changed bindings and later same-binding dissent invalidate readiness.

The production bridge requires structured independent approval for the exact head and contract. Fresh, resumed and source-less publication paths record the milestone; PR-only jobs stop in AwaitChecks before merge dispatch.
A real-Git bridge test pushes to a temporary bare remote, rejects unpublished/old-head/legacy-boolean evidence, records PR readiness, and leaves confirmed merge count zero.
Status separates requested PR completion from observed merge completion. A PR observer joining merge-enabled work does not downgrade merge authority or rewrite cached admission.

Wait observes durable state without running or claiming work. Timeout and client death preserve the submitted job; final PR completion rechecks authorized remote identity/head under the same observation deadline.
limits: Durable status reports the last observed workflow binding. It does not fetch live GitHub state; --wait performs the final current-head check for PR completion.
Automatic re-verification after a changed remote head remains open; wait reports a deferred changed/unverified head instead of success.

The shared bridge uses synthetic structured review evidence in its real-Git test. CLI tests use scripted GitHub and seeded worker checkpoints; this is not a full native-model/live-GitHub completion run.
Pause/resume/cancel/model and adoption controls, complete worker health, Discord initiation/sessions/updates, native CLI acceptance, normal updater rollout and required soaks remain open.
